title: Lesson corpus: 382 lessons across three categories
body: The lessons collection contains 382 records: workflow=242 (63%), architecture=68 (18%), tooling=66 (17%), uncategorized=6 (2%). These lessons are the primary source for fleet behavioral rules (R01–R30). 107 high-confidence lessons (score ≥ 70) were selected for the SFT dataset.
